steps.description: Show that your robot can display "Battery Low" on the LCD for 2 second

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display "Battery Low" on the LCD
2. Play beeping sound 2 times within 1 second
3. Perform step 1 and 2 together

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display "Battery Low" on the LCD
2. Play beeping sound 2 times within 1 second
3. Perform step 1 and 2 together
4. Pressed and hold the Button to display "Restarting" on the LCD
5. When releasing the Button, display "Tablet is ready" on the LCD for 2 seconds

Hint:
1. Wait until Button is pressed
2. Wait until Button is released

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display "Battery Low" on the LCD
2. Play beeping sound 2 times within 1 second
3. Perform step 1 and 2 together
4. Pressed and hold the Button to display "Restarting" on the LCD
5. When releasing the Button, display "Tablet is ready" on the LCD until Button is pressed again
6. When Button is pressed and held, display "Shutting Down" on the LCD
7. When releasing the Button, the program will end.
